## Why TikTok in 2026?

TikTok has over 3 million active users in the Czech Republic. Average daily time on app: 52 minutes. That's a massive opportunity for businesses targeting younger audiences.

And not just younger — demographics are expanding. Users aged 25-44 now make up 38% of Czech TikTok.

## Getting started

### Business account setup

Switch to a Business account for analytics, bio links, and TikTok Ads Manager access.

### Content that works

- Behind-the-scenes footage
- Industry tips and tricks
- Before/after transformations
- Trend reactions with a brand twist
- Customer stories

### Frequency and timing

3-5 videos per week. Best times for Czech audiences: 7-9 AM, 12-2 PM, and 7-9 PM.

## Growth and monetization

### Strategic boost

A new business account with 50 followers doesn't look credible. Services like [KupSledujici.cz](https://kupsledujici.cz/tiktok-sledujici) help build a foundation quickly.

Not as a replacement for content — as a launchpad.

## Conclusion

TikTok is a huge opportunity for Czech businesses. Low barrier to entry, organic reach still works better than other platforms, and the audience keeps growing.
